bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/forms.rs (TextField), springboard/ui/src/text.rs (TextBuffer marked range), springboard/proto/src/lib.rs (ToApp 60-63, TextState, CaretRect, InputTraits), springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs (composition mapping, popup_origin), springboard/src/shell/keyboard.rs (Composition), springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (text input Ctx hooks), springboard/ui/src/imk_host.rs (Host, Engine, KanaEngine, HangulEngine), springboard/src/shell/input_providers.rs (Providers, AppClient, FieldClient), springboard/ui/src/imk_client.rs (TextInputClient for TextEditor)
summary: BifrOSt covers the client side of composition (an app text field draws marked text and reports its caret) and, since 2026-10-19, the provider side in one process: the shell loads input method folders with an Info dictionary, lists their modes in the menu bar input menu, and routes the keys of the Search field and of the focused field of an external app to the selected method, which composes through a conversion engine and offers a candidate window. Missing: a third-party provider process over the window server's input method protocol, dictionary engines (kanji, pinyin) and pointer clicks on the candidate window.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/input_method.rs (Server); springboard/ui/src/imk_host.rs (Host::register, connect, disconnect); springboard/src/shell/input_providers.rs (Providers, AppClient, FieldClient)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19: Host registers an input method from its Info dictionary, starts a Server for it and gives every connected client one session (the Search field is client 0, an external app in slot n is client n+1). The shell scans <root>/input-methods/*/Info.plist at start. Not built: a provider that runs as its own process and connects over the window server (the shell serves no wl_seat input_method to a third party). Midget check: on Midget put an input method folder at /var/lib/springboard/input-methods/Kana.imk/Info.plist (keys CFBundleIdentifier org.example.kana, BifrostEngine kana, BifrostLanguage ja, IMKControllerClass KanaController, IMKModeDictionary with the mode romaji labelled Romaji), run `bifrost pc midget update --restart` and unlock with `bifrost pc midget key enter`, open the input menu in the menu bar (it lists Romaji), choose it, press Cmd+Space to open Search and type ka; the Search card shows か as underlined marked text with a list か, カ; choose another keyboard in the input menu and the list is gone.

gaps: No third-party input method provider process: a method must be a folder with an Info.plist and a built-in engine (BifrostEngine); nothing connects over the window server's input method protocol.
No dictionary conversion (kanji, hanja, pinyin candidates); Telex, VNI and the other composers in src/shell/input_methods are not hosted by the new Host.
Pointer clicks on the candidate window and clicks into the marked text are not forwarded (Host::pick_candidate and Host::mouse exist); editing commands from the menu do not go through Host::command.
The selected input mode is not saved across a restart and Ctrl+Space cycles the layouts only.
The keyboard app still emits no Preedit of its own and does not draw the provider's candidates.
